raised.claim: isLegalScope returns true for a scope that has non-empty beer_ids but whose where consists only of a review_class term.
raised.why_it_breaks: Model emits new_issue with scope {beer_ids:[10], where:[{col:'review_class',op:'=',value:'matcher_bug'}]}; isLegalScope accepts it so the issue is created; later row 99 with matcher_bug verdict satisfies rowSatisfiesScope (not in beer_ids but the review_class term matches verdictClass) and attaches, recreating the whole-class dumping-ground case the guard was written to prevent.

raised.claim: Outcome.notOnUntappd / wontfix counters are incremented for every quiet verdict that is not still not_on_untappd, including degraded matcher_bug and untargeted actionable verdicts.
raised.why_it_breaks: Guard 3 (no probe) rewrites a not_on_untappd verdict to review_class:'matcher_bug' and pushes it to quiet; the loop sees matcher_bug and does outcome.wontfix++ (likewise for the !hasIssue&&!hasKey case that also pushes parser_bug/matcher_bug); buildTriageLine therefore emits a wrong "wontfix" count for runs that actually produced zero terminal quiet classes.
